_comment: Season of Weaving's header: 'Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.' Each mode has a price in paws and the selection is a multiset within the budget. t_budget_as_count is the near miss -- up_to with count 5 -- which permits five copies of the three-paw mode.

cards.name: Test Budget Spell
cards.oracle_text:
Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.
{P} — You gain 1 life.
{P}{P} — You gain 4 life.
{P}{P}{P} — You gain 9 life.
